_comment: Era-compiler + assembler-shim toolchain for the decomp substrate C path (docs/SUBSTRATE.md). Hash METADATA only — nothing copyrighted (GPL gcc, MIT maspsx); binaries live OUTSIDE the repo under ~/abl-toolchain (ABL_OLDGCC_DIR / ABL_MASPSX override). All three cc1 run natively as 32-bit i386 static ELF on Fedora 44 (no container needed); podman is the documented fallback. Verified 2026-07-08: the SetPolyGT4 pipeline (cpp -> cc1 -O2 -G0 -mcpu=3000 -> maspsx --dont-expand-li -> gnu as) reproduces the target bytes exactly for all three.

assembler_shim.role: translate cc1 MIPS asm to GNU-as-compatible input with ASPSX semantics
assembler_shim.note: stdin cc1 .s -> stdout gnu-as .s; key axis --dont-expand-li vs default (li of a small positive const -> addiu vs ori); --aspsx-version sweeps assembler-version nuances

gnu_as.note: system cross-binutils; ld -m elf32ltsmip, objcopy -O binary (already used by the asm path)
